dominant_strengths: Massive serif wordmark 'ORYZO AI' delivers strong visceral impact and confident editorial typography against neutral canvas
Hero product photo with cutting-mat ruler and tactile cork object communicates craft and physicality clearly
Clean Awwwards chrome on top, generous whitespace around title creates a calm SOTD presentation frame
dominant_weaknesses: Overlapping UI layers (cookie banner, floating bottom nav, side meta) crowd the hero and fight the product photo
Pale beige background plus muted greens and bottom black pill create a tonal mismatch lacking a unifying palette logic
Navigation INTRO/FEATURES/PRODUCT/CONTACT looks generic; little evidence of motion choreography or distinctive interaction signal in the still
fix_priorities: Defer or restyle cookie modal so it doesn't collide with the persistent bottom nav during first impression
Tighten color system: align Awwwards frame, hero photo, and overlays to a single warm-neutral + accent rule
Inject a signature interaction or kinetic type moment to push innovation and motion scores beyond standard SOTD baseline
Increase contrast/hierarchy in embedded site nav so it feels intentional rather than templated
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral leads via giant serif and tactile photography, but behavioral suffers from stacked overlays and reflective payoff is thin without a distinct conceptual hook.
rationale.intent_fit: It reads as a plausible Awwwards SOTD entry with editorial polish, yet feels mid-tier rather than category-defining for the awards brief.
